description: This file contains unit tests for atomic operations, including single-threaded and multi-threaded tests for compare_exchange_strong, fetch_add, fetch_sub, increment, and decrement, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: TestThread
classes.description: Base class for creating threads that override Run() method, wraps pthread_create and pthread_join.

classes.name: CompareExchangeThread
classes.description: Thread class that performs compare_exchange_strong operations on an atomic variable, recording previous values.

classes.name: IncrementAndDecrementThread
classes.description: Thread class that performs a sequence of increment and decrement operations on an atomic variable.

classes.name: FetchAddSubThread
classes.description: Thread class that performs fetch_add and fetch_sub operations on an atomic variable.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Virtual method overridden in subclasses to execute thread-specific logic.
